class.name: NNBTLookAt3D
class.brief_description: Turns a node in 3D space to face the target.
class.description: Rotates [member rotated_node], or the root's actor when none is set, until its forward axis points at the target. The target is resolved from [member target_source] on every tick, in global coordinates, and the node turns the shortest way round. The rotation changes by at most [member turn_rate] radians per second, so a turn spans several ticks and the leaf returns [code]RUNNING[/code] until the remaining angle is within [member angle_tolerance] and then [code]SUCCESS[/code]. Returns [code]SUCCESS[/code] without rotating when the target is at the node's position, or when the target is directly above or below it. Returns [code]FAILURE[/code] in the editor, when the resolved target was freed or is missing, and when the node to rotate is missing or is not a [Node3D]. Configuration errors are reported once per node instance.

members.member: The remaining angle in radians at or below which the node is considered facing the target. A smaller tolerance makes the leaf rotate for longer.
The node to rotate. When unset, the root's actor is rotated and must be a [Node3D]. Set this to turn a visual child instead of the actor itself.
The target position in global coordinates, used when [member target_source] is [constant NNBTSpatialActionLeaf.TARGET_POSITION].
The maximum turn speed in radians per second. [code]0[/code] turns instantly.
When [code]true[/code], the +Z axis is the front of the node, as in [method Node3D.look_at]. When [code]false[/code], the forward axis is -Z. Applies to both [member yaw_only] modes.

When [code]true[/code], the node turns about the global Y axis only, comparing headings on the XZ plane and ignoring the target's height and the node's existing pitch and roll. When [code]false[/code], the node turns fully to point its forward axis at the target with global Y as up.
